label: Python mutation testing (mutmut)
description: Mutation testing of Python components with mutmut 3, in a copy of the component inside the run folder. Comes in by evidence: only when the component has tests configured for pytest (pytest.ini, conftest.py, [tool.pytest.ini_options]...) or a mutmut configuration; runs only where mutation is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Bounded to 15 minutes (timeoutSeconds 900): a run that exceeds it has no score. mutmut is the project's own dev dependency and does not run natively on Windows (use Linux, macOS or WSL).
